name: BOUND anon-rpc probe
description: Manual dev probe: boots the real 'nox' anon-rpc worker (Sepolia) and makes one anonymized eth_chainId call, to confirm the harness actually works in a real browser before BOUND's extension depends on it.
//host_permissions: Public Sepolia RPC endpoints, for the offscreen document's §4 specifier read AND this service worker's own bootstrap RPC call. The worker's own anonymized fetches do not use these — it runs at a null origin, subject to ordinary CORS, same as any web page.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src *;
